description: Music and audio metadata for African and global repertoire: title, artist, ISRC, artwork, and a playable preview clip when the source provides one. Each row carries a "label" block that names its owner and how many public posts draw on it, and an "attribution" note. A recording is credited to the artist who owns it, never to the accounts whose posts used it; a recording with no Streamlivr owner is retained by the platform.
